sanskrit: yad aśvinā oṣadhīṣv āsiktaṃ puṣkarasrajā vīrudho madhu bibhrati | tenāham asyā mūrdhānam abhi ṣiñcāmi nāryāḥ ||
english: Whatever honey the Aśvinā, lotus-garlanded, have poured into the plants, which the herbs carry — with that I anoint the head of this woman.

sanskrit: yad aśvinā puṣpād adhi mākṣikaṃ madhu saṃbhṛtam | anne lavaṇe yan madhu tenā(…) ||
english: Whatever honeybee-honey the Aśvinā have gathered from the flower, whatever honey is in food and salt — with that [I anoint her head].

sanskrit: yad aśvinā gulgunyā- -āñjane madhu saṃbhṛtaṃ yad asmin madhughe madhu | (…) ||
english: Whatever honey the Aśvinā have gathered in guggulu-resin, in collyrium, whatever honey is in this honey-jar — [with that I anoint her head].

sanskrit: yad aśvinākṣa madhu goṣv aśveṣu yan madhu | surāyāṃ sicyamānāyāṃ kīlāle 'dhi yan madhu | tenā(…) ||
english: Whatever honey the Aśvinā have in the eyes of cattle, whatever honey is in horses, whatever honey rests upon the surā as it is poured, upon the sweet mead — with that [I anoint her head].

sanskrit: yad aśvinā govarcasaṃ hiraṇyavarcasaṃ hastivarcasam aśvinā | tenāham asyā mūrdhānam abhi ṣiñcāmi nāryāḥ ||
english: Whatever radiance of cattle, whatever golden radiance, whatever radiance of elephants the Aśvinā hold — with that I anoint the head of this woman.

sanskrit: abhi nandam abhi modam abhi darpaṃ kṛṇomi te | ā te bhagaṃ vartayatām aśvinā puṣkarasrajā ||
english: I make for you delight, I make exultation, I make pride. May the Aśvinā, lotus-garlanded, turn your good fortune toward you.

sanskrit: datsu te varcaḥ subhage jihvāyāṃ te madhūlakam | akṣyau nikaraṇī tava pratīkaṃ madhumattaram ||
english: Radiance upon your teeth, O fair one; honey upon your tongue. Your face, with its two alluring eyes, is sweeter than sweet.

sanskrit: ā sacasva talāśeva vṛkṣa ivāpatikaḥ patim | tvaṃ sam agrabhīḥ puṃsaḥ śyena ivānyān patatriṇaḥ ||
english: Cleave to your husband as the talāśa-creeper to a tree, as a vine to its support. You have seized the man — as a falcon seizes other birds.

sanskrit: ā hi te hārṣam udakam apo bhagābhiṣecanīḥ | yat te varco 'pakrāntaṃ mukhasya praticakṣaṇāt | punas tad aśvinā tvayy ā dhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā ||
english: I have fetched for you the water, the waters that bestow good fortune through anointing. Whatever radiance has departed from the aspect of your face — may the Aśvinā, lotus-garlanded, restore it to you.

sanskrit: abhi tvā varcasāsicaṃ divyena payasā saha | yathā pativatny aso devṛgbhyo madhumattarā ||
english: I have anointed you with radiance together with celestial milk, so that you may be a devoted wife, sweeter than sweet to your brothers-in-law.

sanskrit: bhagaṃ te mitrāvaruṇā bhagaṃ devī sarasvatī | bhagaṃ te aśvinobhā- -ā dhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā ||
english: May Mitra and Varuṇa bestow prosperity upon you; may the goddess Sarasvatī bestow prosperity; may both the Aśvinā, lotus-garlanded, bestow prosperity upon you.

sanskrit: patiṃ te rājā varuṇaḥ patiṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ | patiṃ ta indraś cāgniś ca patiṃ dhātā dadhātu te ||
english: May king Varuṇa assign you a husband; may the god Bṛhaspati assign you a husband; may Indra and Agni assign you a husband; may Dhātṛ bestow a husband upon you.

sanskrit: catasras te khala sraktīr atho madhyam ahaṃ khala | dhārāś catasra stoṣyāmi vediṃ manuṣyavardhanīm ||
english: The threshing-floor has four corners, and I am the center of the threshing-floor. I shall praise the four streams, the altar that causes humanity to prosper.

sanskrit: ūrjasvantam ā rabhadhvaṃ sphātimantaṃ punītana | indro bījasyābhyāvoḍhā bhaga aitu purogavaḥ ||
english: Seize upon that which is full of vigor, purify that which is full of abundance. Indra is the bearer who brings the seed to fullness; may Bhaga come as leader of the herd.

sanskrit: bhagasya hy anaḍvāhau yuñjāthāṃ rāśivāhanau | adhā pṛthivyāḥ kīlālam ihā vahatam aśvinā ||
english: For Bhaga's two bullocks — the carriers of heaped grain — are yoked. Now, O Aśvinā, bring hither the sweet essence of the earth.

sanskrit: abhivṛtaḥ parihito dhānyena vibhuḥ prabhuḥ | bhartā manuṣyāṇāṃ jajñe devānām ājyaṃ khalaḥ ||
english: Covered over, surrounded by grain, pervading and lordly — the threshing-floor is born as the sustainer of humankind, the clarified butter of the gods.

sanskrit: sruca āsan pavanīḥ sṛṇīkāḥ paridhiṣkṛtaḥ | kīnāśā āsan hotāro bījadā āsīd dhaviṣpatiḥ ||
english: The winnowing-sieves were the purifying ladles; the sickles were the encircling faggots; the husbandmen were the hotṛ-priests; the seed-giver was the lord of the oblation.

sanskrit: ihendra muṣṭī vi sṛjasva pūrṇāv iha saumanasaḥ sam ṛdhyatām | hutādo ye ca gandharvās ta iha sphātiṃ sam ā vahān ||
english: Here, O Indra, release both your full fists; here may goodwill be fulfilled. Those Gandharvā who feed on oblations — may they bring abundance here.

sanskrit: atipaśyo nicāyaka iḍukaḥ pakvam ā bhara | īśānā gandharvā bhuvanasya sarva ā vahantu khale spātim iha sūnṛtāṃ ca ||
english: O far-seer, O discerning one, O iḍuka — bring the ripe grain! May the Gandharvā, lords of all existence, bring abundance to the threshing-floor and true words of blessing here.

sanskrit: ā paścād ā purastād ottarād adharād uta | indreha vasor īśānaḥ khale sphātiṃ sam ā vaha ||
english: From behind and from before, from the north and from below as well — O Indra, lord of riches, bring abundance here to the threshing-floor.

sanskrit: sphātim indraḥ khale bahvīm ihot prāṇa ut pṛṇat | sphātiṃ me viśve devāḥ sphātiṃ somo atho bhagaḥ ||
english: Indra has filled the threshing-floor here with great abundance, has breathed it full, has filled it up. May all the gods give me abundance; may Soma give abundance, and Bhaga.

sanskrit: sphātir me astu hastayoḥ sphātir yatra parārabhe | śatahastedam ut pṛṇa samudrasyeva madhyataḥ ||
english: May abundance be in my hands; may abundance be wherever I begin. Fill this up with a hundred hands, as if from the middle of the ocean.

sanskrit: iha me bhūya ā bhara yathāhaṃ kāmaye tathā | yathedam ud iva sphāyātai traya iva hastinaḥ saha ||
english: Bring it here to me in abundance just as I desire. May this swell up as if three elephants together were swelling here.

sanskrit: svādvīṃ tvā mitrāvaruṇā svādvīṃ devī sarasvatī | svādvīṃ tvā aśvinā sure kṛṇutāṃ puṣkarasrajā ||
english: May Mitra and Varuṇa make you sweet, O surā; may the goddess Sarasvatī make you sweet; may the Aśvinā, lotus-garlanded, make you sweet.

sanskrit: yām asiñcan saudhanvanā viśve devā marudgaṇāḥ | yām aśvināsiñcatāṃ sā surā bahu dhāvatu ||
english: The surā that the saudhanvanā — all the gods and the Marut-hosts — have poured out, the surā that the Aśvinā have poured — may that surā flow abundantly.

sanskrit: svādoḥ svādīyasī bhava madhor madhutarā bhava | yatha rśyasyeyam āriśy evā tvaṃ subhage bhava ||
english: Become sweeter than the sweet; become more honeyed than honey. As this is the she-spotted-deer of the spotted deer, so become you, O fair one.

sanskrit: abhrāj jātaṃ varṣāj jātam atho jātaṃ divas pari | atho samudrāj jātaṃ tat surādaraṇaṃ bhava ||
english: That which is born from cloud, born from rain, born also from around heaven, born also from the ocean — may that become the splitting-vessel of the surā.

sanskrit: nāḍī nāmāsi januṣā sā surādaraṇī bhava | sakhā hi bhadras ta āsīd vṛkṣaḥ svāduvikaṅkataḥ ||
english: By birth you are called Nāḍī — be the splitting-vessel of the surā. For your companion was the blessed tree, the sweet vikaṅkata.

sanskrit: asuras tv aurdhvanabhasaś cakāra prathamaḥ sure | sure dāsasya tvā gṛhe śiraś cāndhaś ca cakratuḥ ||
english: The asura Aurdhvanabhas first fashioned you, O surā. In the house of the dāsa they made the head and the blindness of you, O surā.

sanskrit: niṣ puṣpakaṃ kaśīkāyā nir dhārāyāḥ surām uta | ud ehi vājinīvati kim aṅkatiṣv icchasi ||
english: From the kaśīkā pour out the little blossom; pour out the surā from the stream as well. Come forth, O you rich in sustenance — what do you seek among the aṅkati-vessels?

sanskrit: ime te janyā āsate gambhīrā abhidhṛṣṇavaḥ | sure devi pari prehi mādayantī janaṃjanam ||
english: These your kinsmen sit here, deep-natured and bold. O divine surā, flow around, gladdening each and every person.

sanskrit: yasyā gṛhṇanti sthālena gām aśvaṃ dhānyaṃ vasu | sā surā bahu dhāvatu ||
english: She from whose vessel people receive cattle, horses, grain, and wealth — may that surā flow abundantly.

sanskrit: ācarantīḥ parvatebhyaḥ khanamānā anabhrayaḥ | yāsāṃ samudre saṃsthānaṃ yāsāṃ nāsti niveśanaṃ tās te dadatu budbudam ||
english: Those waters flowing down from the mountains, digging their way, free of clouds — those whose dwelling-place is in the ocean, those who have no resting-place — may they give you the bubbling forth.

sanskrit: udaṅkodacemāṃ surāṃ yāṃ hṛdā kāmayāmahe | tāṃ me bhagas tām aśvinā tāṃ ma āvāṭ sarasvatī ||
english: Upward and northward may this surā rise — the one we long for in our heart. May Bhaga give it to me, may the Aśvinā give it to me, may Sarasvatī vouchsafe it to me.

sanskrit: ayaṃ devo mayūlaśaḥ sā surādaraṇaṃ dadat | saṃsravaṇāt prasravaṇād giribhyas pary ābhṛtaḥ | madhye śatasya maṣṭiṣko 'naḍvān iva mehatu ||
english: May this divine mayūlaśa-plant grant the splitting of the surā. Brought from the mountains through confluence and outpouring — may the brain in the midst of the hundred flow out like a bull making water.
